ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are confined to thin, localized linear and circular features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented surface without large-scale geometric white blobs. High-contrast mapping is limited to a dense network of fine-grained linear scratches and small punctate clusters distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with steep converging slopes; the absolute vertex is partially occluded by water surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical irregular contour. The left lobe features a distinct, deep smooth indentation mid-margin. The right lobe displays a jagged, stair-step erosion pattern near the distal tip with small, high-frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve from the central notch toward the distal tips, creating an flared, wing-like geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, high-contrast white circular clusters concentrated along the trailing edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive, multi-directional network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering the majority of the dark-pigmented fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable tissue loss/indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe and a jagged, irregular excision on the upper margin of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The high-density saturation of white rake marks against the dark background creates a complex, high-frequency textural pattern across the entire structure.
